hooks.name: Run tests on Python save
hooks.description: When a .py file under src/, app/ or tests/ is saved, run the test suite and report failures.

action.prompt: A Python file under src/, app/ or tests/ was just saved. From the workspace root, run `python -m pytest -q tests` using the project's Python 3.11 venv interpreter: `.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest -q tests`. Then report the result: if everything passes, say so in one line with the pass count. If anything fails or errors, list each failing test id with a one-line reason taken from the pytest output. Report only. Do not edit any file in src/, app/ or tests/, and do not try to fix the failures unless the user asks.
